dct_creator_sm: Global Water Futures, University of Waterloo.
dct_description_sm: This dataset provides an improved set of forcing data for large scale hydrological models for climate change impacts assessment over most of North America. This data set will be used to support the objectives under the Global Water Futures Program funded by Canada First Research Excellence Fund.
dct_title_s: High-Resolution Meteorological Forcing Data for Hydrological Modelling and Climate Change Impact Analysis over most of North America, 1951-2100
